name: Hanatsubaki Himeko
source:
Himeko's the niece of the infamous Hanatsubaki Goro from [url=/v857]GS1[/url] - thankfully, she's not as painful to look at, though her mannerisms tend towards strange at times when fashion is concerned. She has her own internet column and runs her own store which the protagonist can work at. 

[from [url=http://tokimemo.gs/tokimeki2/himeko.php]Seaside Sketch[/url] and [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/TokimekiMemorialGirlsSide2]TVTropes[/url]]
